about.title: About ChampsNote
about.body: ChampsNote is a companion toolkit for Pokemon Champions players. Beyond a calculator, it aims to automatically diagnose team weaknesses and assist with live matchups.
about.dataBody: All game data comes only from verifiable official/open sources, refreshed automatically via GitHub Actions to track game updates.
about.intro: ChampsNote is an all-in-one utility for Pokemon Champions ranked battles. From damage calculation to team building, automatic diagnosis & coaching, live matchup analysis, meta statistics and community. Everything you need for competitive play, in one place. All game data comes only from verifiable official/open sources and updates automatically as the game changes.

features.d: Only the Pokemon and exclusive Mega Evolutions that actually appear in Pokemon Champions. Search base stats, types, abilities, learnsets and tiers instantly, with per-Pokemon recommended builds and community samples on one screen.

A precise calculator faithful to the Champions SP system (fixed Lv.50, 0–32 per stat). Applies Mega Evolution, weather, terrain, items, abilities and natures, and shows a min–max damage range when the opponent's stats are unknown.

Build 6 Pokemon, allocate SP, and get automatic diagnosis of type weaknesses, speed-tier distribution, coverage against top-meta threats and role balance, plus improvement suggestions. Showdown import/export and image-card sharing included.

Quickly enter the opponent's 6 at the start of a battle and instantly see threat ranking, favorable leads and moves/abilities to watch, relative to your saved team. Designed for a 3-second lookup on mobile.
Ranked usage and adoption rates (moves, items, abilities, nature spreads) and competitive tier rankings, in Korean. Collected monthly to reflect the current meta.
Share your own teams/samples, browse other trainers' samples and use them directly. Likes, comments and reporting are supported, synced across devices with your account.

dataSources.d: Korean/English names and base stats for Pokemon, moves, abilities, items
Champions roster, tiers, and mechanics (officially-mirrored open source)

about.termsBody: ChampsNote is a free, fan-made tool. The service is provided “as is” with no guarantee of calculation/stat accuracy. You are responsible for content you share, must not infringe others’ rights or post unlawful content, and the service may change or stop without notice.
about.contactBody: For bug reports, feature ideas, data corrections, or partnership/donation inquiries, email us below. We’ll get back to you as soon as we can.

why.d: Only Pokemon, Megas and moves that truly exist in Champions, with no mixing in other generations or games.
Beyond a calculator: rule-based automatic diagnosis of your team's holes with concrete fixes.
Large touch targets and minimal input let you check a matchup within 3 seconds mid-battle.
Official/open sources only, kept current by a weekly automated pipeline.

how.d: Check base stats, matchups and damage in the Dex and Calculator.
Assemble 6 Pokemon in the Team Builder with SP, moves, items and nature.
Use auto coaching to inspect weaknesses and speed tiers, then improve.
Enter the opponent's team in the Matchup Assistant to decide your leads.
Publish finished teams/samples to the community and get feedback.

about.updateBody: Pokemon/move/ability/item data come from PokeAPI and Pokemon Showdown (champions mod); usage statistics from the competitive ladder. A GitHub Actions pipeline periodically re-collects and validates the sources, reflecting game updates such as new Pokemon or balance changes automatically.

sections.p: ChampsNote works without an account by default; teams and settings are stored only on your device (browser local storage). No personal data is collected on our servers.
Teams you upload via 'Publish', and the author name you enter, are stored on the server (Cloudflare D1) and shown publicly. Do not upload if you prefer to keep them private.
Third-party ads (e.g. Google AdSense) may appear in the future; ad vendors may use cookies for interest-based ads. This policy will be updated when ads are enabled.
Anonymous usage statistics may be collected to improve the service. Essential storage (settings, teams) uses local storage.
Clearing your browser storage removes local data. To remove a published community sample, please contact us.
Developer: CTkross. Please reach out via the GitHub repository.

stats.subtitle: Pokemon Champions ladder usage stats and meta analysis. See what top players actually run.
stats.tierNote: Note: tiers (Uber/OU, ...) are Smogon's community classification and differ from the in-game Champions season ranking. Real in-game usage/season data appears under 'Usage ranking' below.
stats.fallbackNote: * This ranking is estimated from competitive tiers and base-stat totals until measured usage stats are collected. It is replaced automatically once real data arrives.
stats.usagePending: Real usage/adoption stats are auto-collected weekly from the Pokemon Champions ladder (official API / Smogon Champions stats). Collection is pending; a reference meta classification is shown meanwhile.
